method: Read all eleven manifests entries and current character-card identity/role/desire/boundary text, four regional drama casts and relevant family/adult/injury/consent passages. Viewed selected six boards in groups of two; unselected five were not pixel-viewed. All eleven PNG files and declared source/reference hashes checked. No reference image pixel comparison or runtime test claimed.

limitations: Selected independent pixels viewed only for 142/144/145/148/150/152; 143/146/147/149/151 unviewed. Author QA is not independent visual evidence.
Paired poses are one actor viewed twice, not extra bodies. Multi-person review boards do not establish simultaneous scene attendance or shared consent.

Explicit adult status/relationships/occupations from source govern; unconfirmed exact age, gender and appearances remain proposals. No diagnosis, cure, missing-relative outcome, payment, disclosure permission or narrative resolution certified.
Native pixel grid/palette, pivots, collision, runtime and animation not tested; face/cloth texture exceeds a literal native 40-pixel sprite.

findings.finding: 三行六姿为卡蕾、欧铎、艾蕾，衣装发型可对应。来源明确三人均成人，艾蕾是成年女儿；幼化的简脸仅风格，不能称未成年人。三名自主主体并排不是全家已同意，未画船行、让屋、驻点新班或宽恕。卡蕾包成小腰袋，欧铎绳与艾蕾包均为外观提案；各在正背同画面侧，解剖挂侧/持手需统一。欧铎不是既有港口奥德，不据近音合并。

unviewed_source_notes.note: 仅核来源与提示：呼蕾冬料承诺未必实到，昂朵是衣料检查非诊断者，尤尔只管自家份；未看像素。
仅核来源与提示：阿洛具体班责任与溪悠用水需求分开，孩子未授权新增暴露或危险重演；未看像素。
仅核来源与提示：瑟芬/蓓薇兄妹分人，母亲现况未推定，房位/劳动不得自动互换；未看像素。

identity_boundaries.boh: Boh is Reha’s returned son, not Nisha’s still-missing brother; no missing brother row generated.
identity_boundaries.tina_and_ele: Tina is explicitly an adult dyer/apprentice, one shared person across quests. Ele is explicitly the adult daughter of Kare/Odo; three family adults require separate consent.
identity_boundaries.tanser: Leg injury is source-established, exact side/diagnosis not established. Tanser and Viko are separate patients. Tanser remains at original shore during the specified second scene.
identity_boundaries.tio_belo: Tio is Rosas winemaking apprentice, Belo is Kenos adult cooper apprentice. No replacement of original NPC.
